caption:
A passenger in Tesla's driverless Cybercab streamed Netflix on a 22-inch screen while riding through Austin with nobody behind a wheel.

This is what the inside of a fully autonomous car looks like right now. No driver, no controls, just a huge screen and the city moving past the windows.

Tesla's Cybercab started giving real rides on September 3. It's already on the streets of Austin. This is what it actually feels like to be inside one.
